design_decisions.title: Use ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 for Rev A Module
design_decisions.rationale: The module integrates flash, PSRAM, crystal and RF, improving first-board success and reducing RF/debug risk.
design_decisions.impact: External flash, PSRAM, crystal and bare-chip RF networks are removed from the assembled Rev A design.

design_decisions.title: Use BQ24074-class charger with power-path
design_decisions.rationale: The badge must support USB bring-up and charging behavior closer to the final product.
design_decisions.impact: Power path is USB_5V -> U3 -> VSYS -> AP2112K -> SYS_3V3; charge current must be calculated from the selected protected battery.

design_decisions.title: Keep dual I2S MEMS microphones with hard mute power control
design_decisions.rationale: Stereo/dual-mic capture is central to the badge, but privacy must not rely only on firmware.
design_decisions.impact: MIC_3V3 is switched by U9 under physical mute control while SW_MUTE remains MCU-readable.

design_decisions.title: Keep microSD over SPI for Rev A storage
design_decisions.rationale: microSD simplifies bring-up, WAV/Opus export and field debugging.
design_decisions.impact: SD has SPI pullups, card detect, bulk capacitance and optional switchable SD_3V3.

design_decisions.title: Add 2.13 inch black-white e-paper interface
design_decisions.rationale: Rev A should support a badge display without requiring final screen industrial design.
design_decisions.impact: A dedicated SPI-style EPD connector is added; color display is deferred.

design_decisions.title: Add dynamic NFC tag, not NFC reader
design_decisions.rationale: Phone-tap identity/configuration works at low power and avoids PN532-style reader complexity.
design_decisions.impact: ST25DV04KC-class I2C NFC tag shares the I2C bus and needs antenna/metal-clip layout review.

constraints.name: wroom_antenna_keepout
rules: Place ESP32-S3-WROOM at top board edge with antenna facing outward.
Keep battery, NFC antenna, metal back clip, screws and e-paper FPC away from antenna front/under area.

constraints.name: audio_acoustic_layout
rules: Place MEMS microphone acoustic ports on the outward-facing top/side badge edge.
Do not block ports with enclosure ribs, glue, clip, lanyard hole or screw bosses.
Keep motor, switching power paths and RF antenna away from microphones.
Align bottom acoustic ports to enclosure sound holes and add dust mesh without blocking the port.

constraints.name: nfc_layout
rules: Keep NFC antenna near the back side and away from large copper, battery protection PCB and metal clip.
Do not overlap NFC antenna with pogo/magnetic charging reserve.
Reserve matching/tuning component access near the antenna feed.

constraints.name: usb_layout
rules: Place USB ESD close to Type-C connector.
Route D+/D- as short paired traces with few vias.
Use the USB connector and nearby component pads when probing USB_5V, USB_D_P and USB_D_N.

constraints.name: privacy_firmware_contract
rules: Mute active means no audio capture, no audio file writes and no recording-active state.
D2 is dedicated to recording/privacy indication only.
Firmware must read SW_MUTE immediately after boot and wake.

constraints.name: bringup_test_points
rules: Use J4 UART debug access plus connector and component-pad probing for first-board bring-up.

risks: BQ24074 charge-current, thermal behavior and power-path details must be verified with the selected protected battery.
AP2112K Rev A LDO may limit battery life; Rev B should evaluate buck or buck-boost replacement.
MSM261S3526Z0CM L/R select polarity, bottom-port orientation, reflow limits and acoustic-hole alignment must be verified.
Generated KiCad schematic must be checked to ensure MIC_LR_SEL_R is not shorted to I2S_BCLK.
microSD socket pinout, card-detect behavior, ESD exposure and power-cycling behavior remain Rev A bring-up risks.
ESP32-S3-WROOM antenna can be detuned by enclosure, battery, NFC antenna or metal back clip.
NFC antenna tuning and phone-read reliability depend on enclosure, battery and clip geometry.
E-paper connector pinout and refresh compatibility are TBD until the exact 2.13 inch panel/adapter is selected.
Physical mute switch polarity and enclosure label direction must be verified before PCB release.
